title: 春よ来い (Haru yo Koi — Come, Spring!)
description: A beloved 1923 children's song set in the deep-snow country of Niigata. Little Miichan — based on the lyricist's own daughter — waits by the door in her red-thonged sandals, longing to go outside. The peach buds in front of the house are just as impatient for spring's arrival.
artist: 作詞：相馬御風 / 作曲：弘田龍太郎
license: Public Domain (published 1923; 弘田龍太郎 died 1952, public domain in Japan from 2023)
